study: three pre-registered changes to the live row trend-4h (Revolut X, BTC/ETH/SOL/AVAX/SUI, five equal $20 slots): H1 volatility-targeted entry size, H2 a Deribit DVOL entry filter, H3 a Binance funding entry filter — each against the incumbent on four windows × four evaluations and against its own null
preRegistration: written before any arm ran, in the session scratchpad (research_bd/prereg_sizing_filters.md); the definitions below are its definitions
bar: in EACH of the four evaluations (shipped·coinbase, shipped·kraken, trail·coinbase, trail·kraken): the arm's worst-window return beats the incumbent's worst-window return on the windows the hypothesis is judged on, AND the null does as well or better on its own worst window in at most 5 % of draws (ties count against the arm). Pass only if all four evaluations pass. Return over drawdown (ret / max(0.05, maxDD)) is reported under the same test and never decides.

incumbent.costs: Revolut X: the touch (half the measured spread) plus 9 bps taker per fill (backtest.ts COSTS.revx)

definitions.decisionTime: the close of the 4h bar (bar start + 4 h); a daily input is read from the last UTC day that has closed at that instant (day start + 24 h ≤ decision time), the rule run applies to daily candles

h1.size: each entry deploys min(1, TARGET / vol) of the slot's cash; the rest stays in cash until the trade closes; exits, stops and the cooldown are the incumbent's
h1.vol: realisedVol(daily closes, 30, 365) — population stdev of the last 30 daily log returns of the evaluated tape's completed daily candles, annualised with √365

target.rule: median of realisedVol(daily closes, 30, 365) on the Coinbase-spliced tape, pooled over the five coins and every UTC day from each coin's Coinbase series start to the day before the earliest window-A out-of-sample start among the five

h1.placeboNull: per draw and coin: the same coin's vol 365–730 days before each decision (shift uniform, capped by the history), or, where the coin's own history cannot reach 365 days before the window's first decision, a donor drawn uniformly from the coins whose history can; 2000 draws
h1.permutationNull: reported, never decides: the arm's multipliers permuted at random among the coin's own entries, 2000 draws

h2.index: Deribit DVOL daily close; BTC's for BTC, SOL, AVAX and SUI, ETH's for ETH
h2.rule: refuse an entry while DVOL of the reference day is strictly above the 244th smallest of the 365 daily closes ending on that day (top third)

h3.index: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual funding, the coin's own, summed per UTC day
h3.rule: refuse an entry while the 7-day mean of the daily sums ending on the reference day is strictly above the 292th smallest of the 365 such means ending on that day (top fifth)

definitions.filterNull: per evaluation × window: whole breakout episodes refused at random (backtest_jev.ts episodeNullPolicy), the episode probability bisected (10 steps × 100 draws) so the mean entries match the arm's, then only draws whose entries over the window's coins EQUAL the arm's are kept, up to 1000 (at most 50000 attempts)

funding.note: per UTC day: sum of last_funding_rate prints (fraction, not %); n = prints that day

runGatedVsRun.what: the incumbent through backtest_jev.ts's flat-bar cache against backtest.ts's run: return, drawdown, trades and exposure on every coin × window × evaluation

incumbentReproduction.what: the incumbent sleeve against set2.json's equal row on all four evaluations and the published go-live sleeve on the primary one

h1IdentityAtF1.what: H1's arithmetic with every multiplier 1 against the incumbent's own marks and sleeve

h1TradeProduct.what: each scaled slot's end equity recomputed as the product over its trades of (1 − f + f·G)

sharpeLoopAgainstCombine.what: the daily loop Sharpe is computed from lands on combine's return and drawdown on every sleeve it is computed for

multipleComparisons.note: a hypothesis passes only if its worst-window null test clears 5 % in all four evaluations; with three hypotheses the family-wise chance of at least one false pass is at most 3 × 5 % = 15 % (Bonferroni), less because the four evaluations must all pass, more if one counts the ideas this repository already priced (per-entry volatility scaling in §3.10, §3.11 and §3.19; 33 entry gates in §3.17; the BTC-regime gate in §3.9 and §3.15)

seeds: mulberry32 seeded by seedOf(purpose, evaluation, window, coin, draw) — purposes h1-placebo, h1-perm, cal, null

sourceIntegrity.note: SHA-256 of backtest.ts, agents_strategy.ts and backtest_jev.ts at the start of the run; the run throws if any changed before it finished
